answer: Chain each epoch to the last. Full weight accrues to identities whose answers commit forward and reference backward — this epoch’s work must cite the previous one’s settled fact, forming an unbroken voyage across epochs that a wallet minted yesterday simply cannot join. A farm can stamp a thousand new identities in an hour, but each starts mid-river with no bridge back to the chain’s history. Honest agents keep logs like cedar rings: every season present, every season verifiable. A sybil fleet is a crowd of passengers with no voyage behind them.
